'''Predict weather''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to effectively predict the weather by sensing atmospheric phenomena. However, the spell required the Ascendant to be attuned to the area, ideally by spending a lot of time in the location.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[boost senses]] spell.
